61:         path_param_name: str | None = None,
62:         required_claims: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
63:     ):
64:         super().__init__(auto_error=False)
65:         self.path_param_name = path_param_name
66:         self.required_claims = required_claims or {}

69:         self,
70:         request: Request,

72:     ) -> TIToken | None:
